mapper.select: SELECT r.role_key FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.role_key <> 'admin' ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.role_key <> 'admin' AND m.status = '0' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.perms) <> '' ORDER BY m.perms
SELECT uac.enabled FROM user_author_capability uac WHERE uac.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
